main_text.p: dine ac robore versatur.Fortes habendi sunt qui pro-pulsant injuriam.

Est virtus, quae in perspicientia veri, solertiaq; versatur. Huic duo vitia contraria sunt: Unum, incogni-ta habere pro cognitis: Alterum, nimis magnum stu-diū in rebus obscuris,iisq; non necessariis adhibere.
Est virtus in omnium, quae fiunt, quaeq; dicuntur, ordine & modo versans.
Adhibenda est munditia non odiosa, neq; exquisita nimis, tantum quae fugiat agrestem & inhumanam negligentiam.
Lecturus præcepta prolixiora videat Ethicam Domini Philippi Melanchthonis, Aristotelis, Domini Doctoris Scribonii vel aliorum.
Hactenus est Ethica declarata: sequitur de Oeconomica.
main_text.head: DE OECONO-MICA.
main_text.p: ECONOMICA[?] est ars bene rem fa-miliarem administrandi: Cujus subjec-tum est ars familiaris, in qua tria consi-deranda sunt: Fuga vitiorum, Ars qua vitae necessaria acquirantur,& Conjugiu. Die haußhaltenskunst ist eine kunst wol das heusliche gut zu verwalten: Diese kunst gehet auffs heusliche gut/Da-rin dreyerley müssen betrachtet werden: Die vermei-dung der laster/Die kunst damit des lebens nothurff-tige ding müssen erworbē werde/ vnd der Ehestād.

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "ECONOMICA" is ornate; the first letter is read as E, but it may be a ligature or the Œ of the title, so it is marked [?]. The German passage at the foot is black letter and is transcribed as printed, including the mixed u/v and the macron on "erworbē". The long s is set as plain s throughout, per the rules, though the scan shows an f-like form. The reading "hîc" is taken from the italic type and may carry a mark over the i.
